name: Eternal Ice
description: A sacred mountain whose snowfield breaks in an avalanche.

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya climb the sacred mountain and hear ticking noises; Baishya says her vision led them there.
timeline.quote: You're too impatient. My vision led me right here, I'm sure of it.

pages_say.description: A sacred mountain whose snowfield breaks in an avalanche.
The mountain where an avalanche tore away the snow field.
